programme.title: Adiestrando Para La Caza T1 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: Visitámos um dos rios mais bonitos do norte da província de Zamora, um rio de montanha que alberga uma das trutas mais espectaculares da região. Vamos pescar com colher e com bolo, sempre a observar o que o rio nos indica.

programme.title: Adiestrando Para La Caza T1 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: La emblemática finca de La Atalaya, un vasto dominio de 5.500 hectáreas, donde el Tajo serpentea a lo largo de 80 kilómetros de orillas. Este territorio, con su imponente belleza y su desafiante terreno, será el escenario de cazadores canarios y sus fieles perros. En estas tierras extremeñas, donde la naturaleza se muestra en su forma salvaje, buscan esos días de caza que en las islas escasean.

programme.title: Monteando En La Capital
programme.desc: Eneko y Raúl son dos amigos en busca de aventuras. Quieren cazar un urogallo en Laponia con sus perros de muestra y saben que no será nada fácil. Las perdices nivales están más localizadas pero los urogallos son más difíciles de encontrar. Les han dicho que suelen estar en el bosque pero no siempre es así….

programme.title: Barbos Com Iscas
programme.desc: Ceuta es el epicentro de la pesca deportiva con la celebración del Campeonato Mundial de Pesca Mar Costa Dúos Este evento reúne a equipos de varios países como España, Portugal, Italia, Francia. La importancia del trabajo en equipo, la colaboración y la ayuda mutua son esenciales para el éxito del grupo que se refleja en los logros individuales.

programme.title: Tras El Urogallo De Laponia
programme.desc: Roberto, Luca y Guillem participan en cacerías por Europa de pluma con buenos perros, setters principalmente. Se han acercado a la Laponia Sueca desde Italia y España. Ha sido un viaje largo pero ha merecido la pena. Esta es una de las cazas más auténticas, los parajes son inmensos y casi vírgenes. Aquí no hay nucleos poblacionales, ni caminos o pistas forestales.

programme.title: Surfcasting Mundial
programme.desc: El restaurador, cazador y pescador aventurero inglés, Mike Robinson es uno de los chefs más destacados de Gran Bretaña. Acompañamos a Mike, mientras pesca y cosecha los ingredientes naturales que componen algunos de sus platos más famosos en su restaurante Estrella Michelin.

programme.title: Perdices Nivales En Suecia
programme.desc: El restaurador, cazador y pescador aventurero inglés, Mike Robinson es uno de los chefs más destacados de Gran Bretaña. Acompañamos a Mike, mientras pesca y cosecha los ingredientes naturales que componen algunos de sus platos más famosos en su restaurante Estrella Michelin.

programme.title: Pesca Y Chef T2 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: La familia Fernandes, con su patriarca a la cabeza lleva un siglo cazando sobre todo la menor. A lo largo de las distintas generaciones el respeto por la naturaleza ha sido su principal seña de identidad.

programme.title: Pesca Y Chef T2 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: El restaurador, cazador y pescador aventurero inglés, Mike Robinson es uno de los chefs más destacados de Gran Bretaña. Acompañamos a Mike, mientras pesca y cosecha los ingredientes naturales que componen algunos de sus platos más famosos en su restaurante Estrella Michelin.

programme.title: Caçando De Aproximação O Robecu
programme.desc: Um grupo de pescadores, desloca-se até ao porto desportivo de Mazagón, para nos mostrar a emoção e a adrenalina que sentem quando têm uma picada e lutam para apanhar os bonitos do sul.

programme.title: Chocos Galegos
programme.desc: No século XIX, a Espanha viveu várias guerras no seu território, conhecidas como as Guerras Carlistas. Havia muitas áreas em conflito, geralmente as mais acidentadas e isoladas dos principais centros populacionais. Hoje, no século XXI, estas mesmas serras escondem algumas boas populações de machos monteses, por vezes com qualidades surpreendentes.

programme.title: Mazagón: Bonitos Do Sul
programme.desc: Nas serras que circundam a vila de Mêda, considerada a capital da Matilha em Portugal, realizam-se várias provas de caça clássica, com grande ambiente e sabor a aldeia, com caçadores que são também agricultores e criadores de gado. O seu objetivo é proteger as suas preciosas vinhas do ataque das abundantes varas de 'porcos-bravos', como são conhecidos os javalis em Portugal.

programme.title: Monteses Em Terra Carlista
programme.desc: Esta vez monteamos a los pies de Madrid. Una gran mancha en abierto que siempre ha dado alegrías a los Monteros que han tenido la suerte de poder disfrutarla. Puestos naturales y una experiencia de muchos años por parte de los organizadores harán disfrutar de lo lindo a los invitados que hoy pisan esta bonita mancha.

programme.title: Lances Monteiros Na Serra De Meda.
programme.desc: O barbo é um peixe potente e muito desportivo, mas alguma vez o pescaram com vinis? Neste episódio vamos ensinar a pescar barbos com vinis tanto no rio como na barragem. Vinis muito pequenos, grandes, flutuantes ou fundidos. Porque é que é tão importante saber andar numa margem? Porque é que saber qual a margem a escolher pode fazer diferença no sucesso da pescaria.

programme.title: Monteando En La Capital
programme.desc: Eneko y Raúl son dos amigos en busca de aventuras. Quieren cazar un urogallo en Laponia con sus perros de muestra y saben que no será nada fácil. Las perdices nivales están más localizadas pero los urogallos son más difíciles de encontrar. Les han dicho que suelen estar en el bosque pero no siempre es así….

programme.title: Streamerman T2 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: Con la obediencia básica conseguida es hora de enseñar a lacear correctamente o aguantar una muestra firme. El respeto a tiro y al vuelo son tareas reservadas a cazadores y perros expertos.

programme.title: Trutas Na Montanha De Zamora
programme.desc: Toda una campeona del mundo de surfcasting, Andrea Pina, es la invitada de este nuevo episodio de Play Pesca. Odei Jainaga, el presentador del podcast, charlará con Andrea sobre la pesca en el mar, qué supone la alta competición y el auge de la captura y suelta también para las cañas de agua salada.

programme.title: A Câmara T1 - Ep. 7
programme.desc: Madrid se ha convertido en los últimos años en uno de los mejores cazaderos para la paloma torcaz. En toda la provincia se realizan extraordinarias tiradas.

programme.title: Play Pesca T1 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: Roberto, Luca y Guillem participan en cacerías por Europa de pluma con buenos perros, setters principalmente. Se han acercado a la Laponia Sueca desde Italia y España. Ha sido un viaje largo pero ha merecido la pena. Esta es una de las cazas más auténticas, los parajes son inmensos y casi vírgenes. Aquí no hay nucleos poblacionales, ni caminos o pistas forestales.

programme.title: Douradas Em Valencia
programme.desc: Hermanos errantes (Dropped en Inglés) es una serie de televisión de estilo documental que sigue a los hermanos Chris y Casey Keefer mientras intentan sobrevivir en zonas remotas durante 30 días. El programa pone a prueba las habilidades de caza, pesca y supervivencia de los hermanos en entornos hostiles.

programme.title: À Seca No Alén
programme.desc: Jose Martínez Couñago apresenta-nos diferentes artes de pesca que se encontram no limite da sua própria existência. Desta vez, aproveita a época de reprodução dos chocos para capturá-los.

programme.title: Hermanos Errantes T7 - Ep. 7
programme.desc: Pescando en aguas misteriosas sigue al aventurero de pesca extrema Cyril Chauquet mientras viaja porlos cauces fluviales peligrosos y remotos en busca de algunas de las últimas especies de peces salvajes que quedan en el planeta.

programme.title: Pesca Em Perigo De Extinção: Chocos À Mão
programme.desc: Ceuta es el epicentro de la pesca deportiva con la celebración del Campeonato Mundial de Pesca Mar Costa Dúos Este evento reúne a equipos de varios países como España, Portugal, Italia, Francia. La importancia del trabajo en equipo, la colaboración y la ayuda mutua son esenciales para el éxito del grupo que se refleja en los logros individuales.

programme.title: Pescando Em Águas Misteriosas T1 - Ep. 7
programme.desc: Ceuta es el epicentro de la pesca deportiva con la celebración del Campeonato Mundial de Pesca Mar Costa Dúos Este evento reúne a equipos de varios países como España, Portugal, Italia, Francia. La importancia del trabajo en equipo, la colaboración y la ayuda mutua son esenciales para el éxito del grupo que se refleja en los logros individuales.

programme.title: Surfcasting Mundial
programme.desc: El restaurador, cazador y pescador aventurero inglés, Mike Robinson es uno de los chefs más destacados de Gran Bretaña. Acompañamos a Mike, mientras pesca y cosecha los ingredientes naturales que componen algunos de sus platos más famosos en su restaurante Estrella Michelin.

programme.title: Palomas En Madrid De Sur A Norte
programme.desc: Josu Perez Larruskain é, além de um conhecido pescador de competição de pesca com mosca, guia de pesca estabelecido no Chile há oito anos. Visitaremos os cenários em um dos rios que mais peixes produzem na Região dos Rios, na Patagônia Norte.

programme.title: Reclamando En Pareja
programme.desc: Pescando em águas misteriosas segue o aventureiro de pesca extrema Cyril Chauquet enquanto ele viaja pelos cursos fluviais perigosos e remotos à procura de algumas das últimas espécies de peixes selvagens que restam no planeta.

programme.title: Trutas Chilenas Do Calcurrupe
programme.desc: Las batidas jabalineras están en pleno auge en el norte peninsular. la explosión demográfica del suido propicia que las coyas sean cada vez más eficaces.

programme.title: Pescando Em Águas Misteriosas T1 - Ep. 8
programme.desc: Hermanos errantes (Dropped en Inglés) es una serie de televisión de estilo documental que sigue a los hermanos Chris y Casey Keefer mientras intentan sobrevivir en zonas remotas durante 30 días. El programa pone a prueba las habilidades de caza, pesca y supervivencia de los hermanos en entornos hostiles.

programme.title: De Batida En El Pirineo
programme.desc: Um grupo de pescadores, desloca-se até ao porto desportivo de Mazagón, para nos mostrar a emoção e a adrenalina que sentem quando têm uma picada e lutam para apanhar os bonitos do sul.

programme.title: Chocos Galegos
programme.desc: No século XIX, a Espanha viveu várias guerras no seu território, conhecidas como as Guerras Carlistas. Havia muitas áreas em conflito, geralmente as mais acidentadas e isoladas dos principais centros populacionais. Hoje, no século XXI, estas mesmas serras escondem algumas boas populações de machos monteses, por vezes com qualidades surpreendentes.

programme.title: Mazagón: Bonitos Do Sul
programme.desc: Nas serras que circundam a vila de Mêda, considerada a capital da Matilha em Portugal, realizam-se várias provas de caça clássica, com grande ambiente e sabor a aldeia, com caçadores que são também agricultores e criadores de gado. O seu objetivo é proteger as suas preciosas vinhas do ataque das abundantes varas de 'porcos-bravos', como são conhecidos os javalis em Portugal.

programme.title: Pesca Y Chef T2 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: La perdiz roja está considerada como la reina de la caza menor. Su escasez, en estado salvaje la convierte en una de las aves más demandadas en todo el territorio nacional.

programme.title: Pescasub En Elantxobe
programme.desc: Pescasub En Elantxobe

programme.title: A Câmara T1 - Ep. 8
programme.desc: Montería celebrada en uno de los santuarios de la modalidad: Los Yébenes. Esta comarca ubicada en la provincia de Ciudad Real alberga multitud de fincas tanto abiertas como cerrada. en esta ocasión jabalíes y venados serán los protagonistas.

programme.title: Berreia Aberta No Principado
programme.desc: Alejandro, Diego e David são três amigos que pescam juntos alguns fins de semana e frequentam o Limia em Ourense. Um rio que tem muitas trutas, mas às vezes está um pouco cheio e isso dificulta a pesca. Também pescam no rio Deva, um rio de montanha, estreito e muito arborizado, com trutas pequenas mas divertidas.

programme.title: Lances Monteros En Ciudad Real
programme.desc: Las pruebas alemanas para razas como el Braco o el Drahthaar están encaminadas a conseguir perros polivalentes aptos para distintas modalidades. Manuel nos muestra los distintos aspectos de estas exigentes pruebas.

programme.title: Trutas Nos Rios Limia E Deva
programme.desc: La emblemática finca de La Atalaya, un vasto dominio de 5.500 hectáreas, donde el Tajo serpentea a lo largo de 80 kilómetros de orillas. Este territorio, con su imponente belleza y su desafiante terreno, será el escenario de cazadores canarios y sus fieles perros. En estas tierras extremeñas, donde la naturaleza se muestra en su forma salvaje, buscan esos días de caza que en las islas escasean.

programme.title: Adiestrando Para La Caza T1 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: Visitámos um dos rios mais bonitos do norte da província de Zamora, um rio de montanha que alberga uma das trutas mais espectaculares da região. Vamos pescar com colher e com bolo, sempre a observar o que o rio nos indica.

programme.title: Canarios En Extremadura
programme.desc: La familia Fernandes, con su patriarca a la cabeza lleva un siglo cazando sobre todo la menor. A lo largo de las distintas generaciones el respeto por la naturaleza ha sido su principal seña de identidad.

programme.title: Hermanos Errantes T7 - Ep. 8
programme.desc: Las batidas jabalineras están en pleno auge en el norte peninsular. la explosión demográfica del suido propicia que las coyas sean cada vez más eficaces.

programme.title: Familia Fernandes: Un Siglo De Caza
programme.desc: A pesca submarina da corvina mergulha-nos na aventura e na capacidade técnica da apneia. Um dos desafios que o pescador submarino enfrenta é a caça de um poderoso predador.

programme.title: Escola De Surfcasting
programme.desc: O Estany de Almenara, em Castellón, é um espaço natural de grande beleza e valor ecológico que foi fortemente afetado por um recente episódio de anóxia. Neste documentário, acompanhamos dois apaixonados pela pesca — Manu Vidal e Paulino Dasí — na sua tentativa de verificar se a vida ainda resiste nestas águas.

programme.title: Corvina, À Caça Do Eco Prateado
programme.desc: Asistimos a una batida de alta montaña en pleno Valle de Arán, en el corazón de los Pirineos catalanes. Los anfitriones de nuestro equipo serán una cuadrilla o 'colha' local y veremos a sus perros laikas y 'osos de Carelia' en acción. Caza auténtica, natural y dura en un paraje impresionante.

programme.title: Almenara, O Renascer Do Estany
programme.desc: En este episodio de De Montería nos desplazamos a la localidad manchega de Villamanrique (Ciudad Real), para asistir a una montería entre amigos en una preciosa finca. Puestos naturales que ofrecen bonitas carreras de venado en una jornada de gran ambiente y tradición montera.

programme.desc: La emblemática finca de La Atalaya, un vasto dominio de 5.500 hectáreas, donde el Tajo serpentea a lo largo de 80 kilómetros de orillas. Este territorio, con su imponente belleza y su desafiante terreno, será el escenario de cazadores canarios y sus fieles perros. En estas tierras extremeñas, donde la naturaleza se muestra en su forma salvaje, buscan esos días de caza que en las islas escasean.

programme.title: Pesca Y Chef T2 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: La perdiz roja está considerada como la reina de la caza menor. Su escasez, en estado salvaje la convierte en una de las aves más demandadas en todo el territorio nacional.

programme.title: Berreia Aberta No Principado
programme.desc: Roberto, Luca y Guillem participan en cacerías por Europa de pluma con buenos perros, setters principalmente. Se han acercado a la Laponia Sueca desde Italia y España. Ha sido un viaje largo pero ha merecido la pena. Esta es una de las cazas más auténticas, los parajes son inmensos y casi vírgenes. Aquí no hay nucleos poblacionales, ni caminos o pistas forestales.

programme.title: Caçando De Aproximação O Robecu
programme.desc: El restaurador, cazador y pescador aventurero inglés, Mike Robinson es uno de los chefs más destacados de Gran Bretaña. Acompañamos a Mike, mientras pesca y cosecha los ingredientes naturales que componen algunos de sus platos más famosos en su restaurante Estrella Michelin.

programme.title: Perdices Nivales En Suecia
programme.desc: Uma equipa do canal ¿Caça e Pesca¿ viaja até à Bolívia para conhecer uma parte da amazónica boliviana. Vamos viajar mais concretamente desde Stª Cruz até uma localidade indígena chamada Versalles que antigamente se dedicava exclusivamente à exploração da borracha e à pesca. De há poucos anos para cá encontram-se envolvidos num projeto para reorganizar o modo de vida da comunidade com um ambicioso guia de pesca e natureza.

programme.title: Pesca Y Chef T2 - Ep. 3

programme.title: De Viagem: Na Bacia Amazónica Boliviana
programme.desc: La Monteria de la Nava es una de las citas mas esperadas por los aficionados a la caza de los grandes jabalies con garantias. En esta primera parte asistiremos al sorteo de los puestos, la salida de las armadas y cierres y a los primeros lances de una jornada para el recuerdo.

programme.desc: Construída no início dos anos 70, a casa de campo Muskoka do pai de Anita tem ossos fortes, mas está muito ultrapassada.

programme.title: Constrói O Teu Castelo T2 - Ep. 11
programme.desc: Em várias regiões de França, novos proprietários de elegantes, mas muitas vezes degradados, castelos e palácios, lançam-se na aventura de os restaurar e transformar em lares de sonho e negócios sustentáveis.

programme.title: Eco Reset - Ep. 10

programme.title: O Cão Ideal T3 - Ep. 12

programme.title: Cães Com Tarefas Extraordinárias - Ep. 5
programme.desc: Revela o uso do olfato para a ciência. Equipas caninas no Canadá travam a invasão do mexilhão-zebra; no Cabo Ocidental, cães resgatam a rara tartaruga-geométrica; e um cão ajuda cientistas no mar a localizar fezes de orcas para monitorizar a saúde da espécie.

programme.title: Lista De Desejos Gastronómicos T2 - Ep. 13
programme.desc: John dirige-se até à cidade louca por brunch, Victoria, na Colúmbia Britânica, para provar o indulgente e super amontoado gofre de confit de pato de que toda a gente anda a falar.

programme.title: Lista De Desejos Gastronómicos T2 - Ep. 14
programme.desc: John mergulha na ementa do local de brunchs preferido de Montreal, no Quebeque, para devorar umas incríveis panquecas altíssimas e descobrir por que motivo este restaurante da nova escola judia está a tomar a cidade de assalto.

programme.title: Lista De Desejos Gastronómicos T2 - Ep. 15
programme.desc: John atira-se de cabeça na combinação italiana dos seus sonhos em Pittsburgh, na Pensilvânia: gnocchi caseiros fofos a nadar numa tigela de pão à moda de Sorrentina cheia de molho.

programme.title: Fire Masters T1 - Ep. 15

programme.title: Fire Masters T1 - Ep. 16
programme.desc: Um prato de autor de inspiração internacional pega fogo ao sonho de ganhar a competição de um dos chefs. A Ronda Crossfire oferece uma oportunidade de pôr a conversa ao lume e os juízes desfrutam de banquetes gregos.

programme.title: Cozinha De Chef T1 - Ep. 15
programme.desc: Inspirada na introdução dos pratos gourmet nos festivais de música em Portugal, Marlene Vieira promete recriar combinações improváveis nos tradicionais croquetes, rissóis e até chamuças. Fica para ver que não te vais arrepender!.

programme.title: Cozinha De Chef T1 - Ep. 16
programme.desc: Em 2018, Marlene Vieira lançou um livro de Doces e neste episódio promete partilhar sugestões de sobremesas que te vão fazer querer comer e chorar por mais! Ah! E sem culpa… que estas não são light mas são na proporção certa!.

programme.title: Comer Pelo Mundo T4 - Ep. 16
programme.desc: Neste episódio Verónica viaja até ao Uganda.

programme.title: Experiências.PT T2 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: Neste episódio, vamos descobrir a capital do artesanato português e tesouros bem guardados como uma fábrica de chocolates, viver encontros improváveis com peregrinos a caminho de Santiago e descobrir por que é que Barcelos é a 'Meca' do hóquei patins.

programme.title: Experiências.PT T2 - Ep. 3

programme.title: Eco Reset - Ep. 11
programme.desc: Na Madeira, Vera Kolodzig e Joana Seixas afastam-se dos roteiros habituais para conhecer uma ilha mais autêntica. Uma aventura marcada pelo contacto com a natureza e por experiências ligadas à terra e ao mar.

programme.title: Eco Reset - Ep. 12

programme.title: Comer Pelo Mundo T2 - Ep. 30
programme.desc: A nossa viajante incansável Verónica Zumalacárregui volta ao Canal com novos episódios de “Comer Pelo Mundo”. Mais uma vez, pela sua mão, iremos conhecer a gastronomia autêntica de cada uma das cidades que visita. Neste episódio Verónica viaja até Macau.

Em Richmond, Vancouver, John vai descobrir o frango frito favorito da cidade, feito com alma pela Mama J.

De seguida, John arregaça as mangas com o mestre da carne em Toronto, Ontário, onde aprende o segredo da sua famosa sanduíche de alce.

Conhecemos também João Bujaca, um mestre da Marinha Grande que, através da lapidação, dá vida e precisão aos desenhos de Catarina.

Guiados por Fátima Lopes, vamos ao encontro desta artista e conhecemos também Nestor Pereira, experiente estucador cujo conhecimento e habilidade dão vida aos desafiantes detalhes do estuque em paredes e tetos.

programme.title: Sucker Punch - Mundo Surreal
programme.desc: Uma jovem é internada num hospício contra a sua vontade. Como estratégia para lidar com tudo, ela recua para uma extravagante realidade alternativa onde se junta a quatro prisioneiras que se tornam guerreiras experientes com a missão de recolher os quatro itens que lhes permitam fugir.

programme.title: Impacto Súbito
programme.desc: Quando uma mulher exerce uma vingança mortal nos agressores que a violaram e à irmã 10 anos antes, matando-os um a um, o inspetor 'Dirty' Harry Callahan é chamado para investigar e resolver o caso.

programme.title: Tom of Finland
programme.desc: A vida e obra do artista finlandês Touko Valio Laaksonen, mais conhecido como Tom of Finland, uma das figuras mais influentes e celebradas da cultura gay do século XX, desde o seu regresso a casa após lutar na Segunda Guerra Mundial até à sua consagração por via dos seus desenhos homoeróticos.

programme.title: Edge Of Fear
programme.desc: Após ter sido esfaqueado e deixado como morto, um homem tenta fazer o impossível: apesar de fraco, sozinho e com uma faca espetada no peito, terá de salvar a mulher dos assassinos que lhes invadiram a casa antes de sangrar até à morte.

programme.title: Respect
programme.desc: De criança que cantava no coro da igreja onde o pai era pastor até ao reconhecimento internacional, “Respect” acompanha a notável história de vida da cantora e compositora norte-americana Aretha Franklin e a jornada que efetuou para encontrar sua voz.

programme.title: O Pai Tirano
programme.desc: Chico ama Tatão, que é cortejada por Artur. Por seu turno, Graça ama Chico mas não sabe que ele ama Tatão. Santana escreve uma peça para os Grandelinhas que servirá de guião à paixão de Chico e convencerá Tatão de que ele é um rico conde. Mas nada vai acontecer como previsto.

programme.title: Robinson Crusoé
programme.desc: Numa pequena ilha paradisíaca, o papagaio Terça-feira e o seu grupo de animais amigos encontram o náufrago Robinson Crusoé. No início, o convívio não é fácil mas lentamente, todos começam a viver juntos em harmonia, pelo menos até dois gatos virem colocar tudo em risco.

programme.title: Antes Do Adeus
programme.desc: Nick e Brooke são dois estranhos retidos em Manhattan durante a noite, que vão gradualmente tornar-se confidentes um do outro. À medida que as horas passam, o inesperado acontece e eles acabam por ser forçados a confrontar os seus medos e assumir o controlo das suas vidas.

programme.title: A Modista
programme.desc: Quando Tilly regressa a casa, numa pequena cidade rural australiana, vai reconciliar-se com a mãe doente e vai recorrer à sua experiência na alta costura para transformar as mulheres locais e vingar-se de quem antes lhe tinha feito mal.

programme.title: Space Jam: Uma Nova Era
programme.desc: Quando LeBron James e o seu filho Dom são aprisionados numa realidade digital por uma Inteligência Artificial, o campeão da NBA terá de os fazer regressar salvos a casa, liderando Bugs, Lola Bunny e todo o gangue dos Looney Tunes numa vitória num jogo de basquetebol como nunca se viu.

programme.title: Hércules - A Lenda Começa
programme.desc: Em 1200 a.C, na Grécia Antiga, o príncipe Hércules desconhece que é filho de Zeus e só deseja o amor da Princesa de Creta, prometida em casamento ao seu irmão. Agora, ele vai ter de fazer uma escolha: fugir com o seu verdadeiro amor ou cumprir o seu destino e tornar-se o grande herói do seu tempo.

programme.title: Força Da Natureza
programme.desc: Uma quadrilha de ladrões planeia um assalto num velho complexo de apartamentos de Porto Rico quando um grande furacão se abate sobre o local. Mas a tarefa vai ser complicada por um polícia que lá está destacado para evacuar o local e um ex-polícia ansioso por voltar ao ativo.

programme.title: Cidade Dividida
programme.desc: Na cidade de Nova Iorque, Billy Taggart, um ex-polícia caído em desgraça trabalha como investigador particular e é contratado pelo presidente da câmara de Nova Iorque, a quem deve um enorme favor, para espiar a sua mulher.

programme.title: As Pequenas Coisas
programme.desc: Em Los Angeles, no início dos anos 90, dois detetives investigam uma série de crimes violentos, num processo complexo que os leva até um estranho solitário que poderá ser o assassino.

programme.title: Underworld - O Submundo
programme.desc: Numa guerra que dura há séculos, os vampiros e lobisomens lutam pela supremacia do Submundo longe do olhar dos humanos. Mas agora os lobisomens planeiam raptar um jovem médico humano para criar uma nova e invencível espécie. Apenas Selene, uma guerreira vampira, pode impedir este plano.

programme.title: Ratazana Assassina
programme.desc: Brody é um ranger que se prepara para abrir um novo parque de campismo, com a ajuda dos sobrinhos. Tudo parece estar em ordem até que uma ratazana gigante, que sofreu uma mutação devido aos resíduos tóxicos, começar a matar tudo o que lhe aparece à frente.

programme.title: Um Traidor Dos Nossos
programme.desc: Um casal de férias em Marraquexe vê-se envolvido nos planos de um oligarca russo para desertar para o ocidente. Entre a mafia russa e os serviços secretos britânicos, o casal é obrigado a fazer uma perigosa viagem por Paris, Berna e pelos cantos mais obscuros da cidade de Londres.

programme.title: O Livro Das Soluções
programme.desc: Marc é um realizador de cinema que leva toda a sua equipa de produção para a pequena aldeia de Cévennes, onde a sua a criatividade gera milhões de ideias que o mergulham no caos total, o que o leva a escrever um guia de conselhos práticos, ‘O Livro das Soluções’…

programme.title: Funcionário Do Mês
programme.desc: Vincent Peltier é um funcionário público que é encorajado a apresentar a demissão quando a tutela começa a impor cortes. Para manter as benesses e evitar tal destino, aceita ser transferido para um dos piores e mais recônditos lugares do mundo, a Gronelândia…

programme.title: Despedida De Casado
programme.desc: Um recém-divorciado tenta superar o trauma da separação através de uma enorme festa de “despedida de casado”.

programme.title: Zona Proibida
programme.desc: John Wall é uma alma perdida que vagueia pela cidade de Nova Iorque e que acaba por ter uma ligação especial com duas jovens com quem passa o aniversário, refletindo sobre os percursos pelos quais as suas vida autodestrutivas os levaram.

programme.title: A Partida
programme.desc: Ben e a sua melhor amiga Tanner resolvem pregar uma partida à professora de Física que ameaça reprová-los, acusando-a falsamente nas redes sociais do homicídio de um estudante.

programme.title: Serenidade
programme.desc: O passado misterioso do comandante de um navio de pesca regressa para o assombrar quando a sua ex-mulher insiste em abordá-lo com um desesperado pedido de ajuda, enredando a sua vida numa nova dimensão em que nada é o que parece.

programme.title: After Depois Da Verdade
programme.desc: Hardin Scott e Tessa Young estão agora separados. Enquanto Hardin ganha hábitos pouco saudáveis, Tessa consegue o estágio dos seus sonhos, onde chama a atenção do seu novo colega, Trevor, inteligente e responsável… No entanto, Tessa não consegue esquecer Hardin, que é, afinal, o amor da sua vida.

programme.title: 21 Pontes
programme.desc: Andre Davis é um detetive da polícia de Nova Iorque que tem de capturar os responsáveis pelas mortes de vários colegas, numa operação-limite onde são fechadas as 21 pontes de Manhattan para impedir a fuga dos assassinos da ilha.

programme.title: Caçadores De Recompensa
programme.desc: Um famoso caçador de recompensas reencontra o seu principal inimigo, um fora-da-lei e um jogador profissional que ele tinha enviado para a prisão anos antes.

programme.title: Ben-Hur
programme.desc: Judah Ben-Hur é um nobre judeu, cuja heroica odisseia inclui ser escravizado pelos romanos, fugir de um barco de escravos durante uma batalha, vingar-se contra os seus carrascos durante uma violenta corrida de quadrigas numa arena e ainda um fatídico encontro com Jesus Cristo.

programme.title: Sucker Punch - Mundo Surreal
programme.desc: Uma jovem é internada num hospício contra a sua vontade. Como estratégia para lidar com tudo, ela recua para uma extravagante realidade alternativa onde se junta a quatro prisioneiras que se tornam guerreiras experientes com a missão de recolher os quatro itens que lhes permitam fugir.

programme.title: Os Ingleses Estão A Chegar
programme.desc: Harriet e Peter Fox são um casal de vigaristas ingleses que, após perderem uma grande soma ao póquer e ficarem a dever dinheiro a uma gangster psicótica, fogem para Los Angeles onde acabam por criar um elaborado plano para roubar um anel à rica ex-mulher de Peter.

programme.title: Verdi - Messa da Requiem
programme.desc: Roberto Abbado conducts the Filarmonica Arturo Toscanini, the Coro del Teatro Regio di Parma, and four vocal soloists in an outstanding performance of Giuseppe Verdi’s Messa da Requiem, recorded at the Parco Ducale di Parma, Italy as part of Festival Verdi 2020. The soloists are soprano Eleonora Buratto, mezzosoprano Anita Rachvelishvili, tenor Giorgio Berrugi, and bass Roberto Tagliavini.

programme.title: Legato - World of the Piano
programme.desc: We live in a 'renaissance of the piano”, as the New York Times has recently put it. With virtuosic flair and an eagerness to expand the repertoire, a new generation of pianists has revitalized the instrument’s appeal. In addition to the usual classics, they perform formerly scorned works or discover neglected composers.

programme.title: Memory of a Concert
programme.desc: In 2006, Gidon Kremer and Martha Argerich set out on tour performing solos and duets by Bartók und Schumann. The last of the concert series at the Berliner Philharmonie has been recorded for this film, featuring a rare solo performance by Martha Argerich. A concert film with personal and moving commentary by Gidon Kremer. Program: Schumann's Violin Sonata No. 1, Op. 10, Violin Sonata No. 2, Op. 121; Kinderszenen, Op.

programme.title: Mozart - Requiem in D minor, K. 626
programme.desc: Daniel Harding leads the Orchestra and Choir of the Maggio Musicale Fiorentino and four vocal soloists in a magnificent performance of Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart’s Requiem in D minor, K. 626. The soloists are soprano Christiane Karg, mezzosoprano Sara Mingardo, tenor Matthew Swensen, and bass Gianluca Buratto. The Austrian Count Walsegg commissioned Mozart to compose a Requiem in July 1791 to commemorate his late wife, Anna.

programme.title: PIAM - Semi-final I: Chopin and Scriabin
programme.desc: Acclaimed classical music talent scout Antonio Mormone (1930-2017) lives on as the name-giver of the Premio Internazionale Antonio Mormone (PIAM), awarded to the winner of the Italian music competition of the same name. The first edition of this competition, which was held in various venues in Milan from 2019 to 2021, was dedicated to the piano.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Mozart - Symphony No. 35, K. 385
programme.desc: Claudio Abbado conducts the Berlin Philharmonic in a performance of Mozart’s “Haffner” Symphony No. 35, K. 385, recorded during the very first Europakonzert in the Smetana Hall in Prague, 1991. Mozart originally composed the symphony as a serenade for the family of Sigmund Haffner, a childhood friend from Salzburg in 1782.

programme.title: Mussorgsky - Night on Bald Mountain
programme.desc: Young Euro Classic is the world’s most important platform for international young orchestra musicians in the European classical music tradition, and for its development. For 17 days every summer, orchestras from all over the world perform at Berlin’s Konzerthaus, on Gendarmenmarkt. This performance features some highlights of the Young Euro Classic edition of 2016.

programme.title: Beethoven - Piano Concerto No. 1 And Symphony No. 2
programme.desc: At the age of seven, Argentine pianist Martha Argerich made her debut with Ludwig van Beethoven’s Piano Concerto No. 1 in C major, Op. 15, a piece that would accompany her throughout her career. The celebrated pianist performs this signature piece at the Lucerne Festival with the Lucerne Festival Orchestra under the baton of Swedish conductor Herbert Blomstedt, who makes his festival debut with the orchestra. Beethoven’s Symphony No.

programme.title: Bach - Partita for Violin No. 2 (BWV 1004)
programme.desc: Celebrated German violinist Isabelle Faust performs J. S. Bach’s Partita No. 2 in D minor (BWV 1004). The work is part of the composer’s well-known Sonatas and Partitas for Solo Violin (BWV 1001-1006). Partita No. 2 is made up of four dance movements, concluded by its famous Chaconne, a monumental piece within the violin repertoire.

programme.title: Patmos – A musical documentary
programme.desc: Every summer, the Greek island of Patmos hosts the Patmos Musical Festival, a unique musical event comprising both a Chamber and a Sacred Music Festival. This documentary captures the 2024 edition, featuring performances by distinguished soloists and ensembles from around the world.

programme.title: Beethoven - Piano Sonata No. 30, Op. 109
programme.desc: Can we get into Beethoven’s creative mind, especially in the last phase of his life, when he was coping with severe hearing loss? Tom Beghin’s new recording of Beethoven’s Piano Sonatas Opus 109, 110, and 111 is an artistic exploration of how Beethoven’s musicking was shaped by the work environment he created with the help of colleagues and friends.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Da Caserta and Filipotti - Dulcedo et Subtilitas
programme.desc: Filippotto and Antonello da Caserta were the first Neapolitan composers whose music was preserved. It is anything but primitive: these two belong amongst the prominent representatives of ars subtilior and the melodic Italian style which musicologist Nino Pirrotta christened “dulcedo.

programme.title: Hearing the Silence
programme.desc: Claudio Abbado was one of the world's finest and most-respected conductors. He held the post of musical director with La Scala in Milan from 1968 to 1986, with the Vienna Opera from 1986 to 1991, and the Berlin Philharmonic from 1989 to 2002.

programme.title: Johan de Meij - Symphony No. 1 “Lord of the Rings”
programme.desc: This concert is the result of the collaboration between the “Giuseppe Nicolini,” Conservatory of Piacenza, and the “Giuseppe Verdi,” Conservatory of Milan, as part of the project 'MIlanoPIACEnza ... suonare insieme”. On the program are works by the Dutch conductor and composer Johan de Meij. His Symphony No. 1 for woodwind and brass orchestra is titled “Lord of the Rings” and is based on the famous trilogy by writer J. R. R Tolkien.

programme.title: Beethoven - Piano Concerto No. 1, Op. 15
programme.desc: Confusing as it may be: Ludwig van Beethoven’s Second Piano Concerto was in fact composed ten years prior to his First Piano Concerto. The cause of this mess lies with the composer himself: Beethoven held back the publication of what we know as the Second Piano Concerto until after that of the First Piano Concerto, so he could thoroughly review the piece.

programme.title: Rimsky-Korsakov - Tale of the Invisible City Suite
programme.desc: In this exquisite 2016 concert from Moscow's Tchaikovsky Concert Hall, the Russian National Orchestra and star-pianist Boris Berezovsky are led by conductor Mikhail Pletnev in a performance of magnificent works by Nikolai Rimsky-Korsakov. Winner of the 1990 International Tchaikovsky Competition in Moscow, Berezovsky interprets the works of Rimsky-Korsakov with a virtuosic power.

programme.title: Caresana, Ziani, Scarlatti - Settimana Santa
programme.desc: ‘True lovers of Italian music’ is how the musicians of the young ensemble L’Escadron volant de la Reine describe themselves. Their fascination with Naples resulted in a programme for Holy Week. A sonata by Ziani, a motet by Caresana and a dialogue by Nola embrace two ‘leçons de ténèbres’ by Alessandro Scarlatti. His Miserere and Sinfonia Terremoto provide the turbulent final note.

programme.title: A Mozart Concert from Berlin
programme.desc: The Carl Philipp Emanuel Bach Chamber Orchestra delivers a program entirely devoted to Mozart at the Konzerthaus in Berlin under the direction of Hartmut Haenchen. In reduced form, the ensemble manages to bring to life the many characteristics of the music and the unique spirit of the famous composer, be it his gaiety of heart, his lyricism, his dramatic side or his polyphonic writing inspired.

programme.title: Beethoven - Symphony No. 9
programme.desc: Conrad van Alphen conducts Sinfonia Rotterdam, the Octopus Symphonic Choir, and four vocal soloists in a performance of Ludwig van Beethoven’s Symphony No. 9 in D Minor, Op. 125 at De Doelen, Rotterdam, in 2019. Van Alphen founded Sinfonia Rotterdam in 2000. Under his passionate leadership, this orchestra has developed into one of the Netherland's best-known orchestras. Beethoven’s Symphony No.

programme.title: Festive Mozart Concert from Salzburg
programme.desc: This performance was recorded during Mozart Week on January 27, 2006 in Salzburg, Austria, at the Großes Festspielhaus (Large Festival House) in celebration of Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart's 250th birthday. Under conductor Riccardo Muti, it features Thomas Hampson (baritone), Mitsuko Uchida (piano), Gidon Kremer (violin), Yuri Bashmet (viola), Wiener Singverein, and Wiener Philharmoniker. Pieces include Piano Concerto No.

programme.title: Beethoven-String Quartet No. 14, Op. 131
programme.desc: Renowned French string quartet Quatuor Ébène marked the 250th birth anniversary of Ludwig van Beethoven (1770-1827) with a remarkable project: recording all of the great composer’s sixteen string quartets. For five years, violinists Pierre Colombet and Gabriel Le Magadure, violist Marie Chilemme, and cellist Raphaël Merlin immersed themselves in Beethoven’s 650 pages of sheet music.

programme.title: Modena - City of Belcanto
programme.desc: This documentary by Mark Perna shows the training and professional growth actions for opera singers, the promotion and enhancement of the cultural offer of the city and province of Modena and the maintenance and development of the Modenese musical tradition in the field of opera.

programme.title: Dvorák - Symphony No. 7, Op. 70
programme.desc: Maestro Iván Fischer leads the Orchestra del Maggio Musicale Fiorentino in a performance of Antonín Dvorák's Symphony No. 7 in D minor, Op. 70. The work was completed in March 1885 and premiered one month later in London conducted by the composer himself. With its dramatic and dark style, this symphony stands in stark contrast to the predominantly optimistic tone of Dvorák’s broader oeuvre.

programme.title: Beethoven - Symphony No. 9, Op. 125
programme.desc: Sir Simon Rattle leads the London Symphony Orchestra (LSO) and Chorus in a performance of Ludwig van Beethoven’s Symphony No. 9 in D minor, Op. 125. The soloists are Iwona Sobotka (soprano), Anna Stephany (mezzo-soprano), Robert Murray (tenor), and Florian Boesch (baritone).

programme.title: Tchaikovsky Symphony 2 And Elgar’s Enigma Variations
programme.desc: The Maggio Musicale Fiorentino (Florence Musical May) is Italy’s oldest opera and arts festival. It was founded in 1933 with the aim of presenting contemporary and forgotten operas. Over the years, the scope widened, and orchestral concerts have long been an integral part of the festival.

programme.title: PIAM - Semi-final I: Liszt and Ravel
programme.desc: Acclaimed classical music talent scout Antonio Mormone (1930-2017) lives on as the name-giver of the Premio Internazionale Antonio Mormone (PIAM), awarded to the winner of the Italian music competition of the same name. The first edition of this competition, which was held in various venues in Milan from 2019 to 2021, was dedicated to the piano.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Handel - The Triumph of Time and Truth
programme.desc: Emmanuelle Haim conducts Le Concert d’Astrée in a rendition of G. F. Handel’s two-part oratorio “Il Trionfo del Tempo e del Disinganno” (The Triumph of Time and Truth). The work with a libretto by Benedetto Pamphili was first performed in Rome, in 1707. Director Krzysztof Warlikowski has taken Handel’s first oratorio, written when the composer was only 22 years old, on in a deep, tender staging.

programme.title: Abbado conducts Mahler and Schönberg
programme.desc: The program is introduced with a short documentation about Schönberg's Pelleas et Melisande, based on a text by Claudio Abbado. Every musical theme relates to a special colour appearing on screen. What has been so remarkable about Abbado’s Mahler performances is that their impact has never been achieved at the expense of the multiple sensitivities, subtleties and extreme sophistication.

programme.title: The 12 Cellists - Documentary
programme.desc: Directed in 2012 by Enrique Sánchez Lansch, the documentary The 12 Cellists follows the 12 cellists of the Berlin Philharmonic Orchestra. Since 1972, this group is a staple of the international musical universe. Whether they play classical music, jazz, tango or avant-garde music, these talented musicians invariably enthrall audiences with the wide range of unique and bewitching sounds they produce with their cellos.

programme.title: Elgar - Concerto for Cello, Op. 85
programme.desc: For over two decades, the Berlin Philharmonic has celebrated its creation on May 1 with the annual Europakonzert, which in 2010 was held in Oxford. Led by Daniel Barenboim, the orchestra and the young American cellist Alisa Weilerstein, who has attracted widespread attention for her passionate yet precise musicianship, perform a breathtaking rendition of Edward Elgar’s Cello Concerto, Op. 85.

programme.title: Chopin - Polonaise-fantaisie, Op. 61
programme.desc: Ukrainian-born pianist Inna Faliks performs Frederic Chopin's Polonaise-Fantaisie Op. 61. Recorded at the Nicols Concert Hall, Evanston, IL, USA. Faliks has established herself as one of the most communicative, and poetic artists of her generation. The Polonaise-Fantaise was dedicated to Mme A. Veyret, composed and published in 1846.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: German Brass goes Bach
programme.desc: The German Brass ensemble delivers some of Bach's most popular tunes in breathtaking brass arrangements. Recorded live from the magnificent St. Thomas Church in Leipzig, this concert features timeless pieces by the legendary German composer, such as Toccata and Fugue in D minor, Adagio in G minor, and Jesus bleibet meine Freude.

programme.title: Mendelssohn - Violin Concerto, Op. 64
programme.desc: Sir Simon Rattle conducts the Berlin Philharmonic in the 2016 edition of the Europakonzert. This time, it takes place at the beautiful Baroque church of Røros, a Norwegian mining town whose intact picturesque old town makes it a UNESCO World Heritage Site. The talented Norwegian violinist Vilde Frang is the star soloist in Mendelssohn’s songful Violin Concerto, Op. 64, which she plays with warmth, elegance and effortless virtuosity.

programme.title: Works by Beethoven and Saint-Saëns
programme.desc: In May and June 2021, Argentinian star pianist Martha Argerich celebrated her 80th birthday performing at Château de Chantilly, France. In this concert, recorded at the festival Les Coups de Cœur de Chantilly, Argerich is joined by three musicians who are particularly close to her heart: cellist Mischa Maisky, violinist Maxim Vengerov, and pianist Iddo Bar-Shaï.

programme.title: Grieg - String Quartet in G minor, Op. 27
programme.desc: String quartet Cuarteto Mendelssohn de BP, in its 2018 configuration of violinists Olga Artyugina and Eva Rabchevska, violist Bella Chic and cellist Hayk Sukiasyan, performs Edvard Grieg’s String Quartet in G minor, Op. 27. Completed in 1878, it is the composer’s second attempt in the genre. His first string quartet, written in the early 1860s, was lost, and the third one was left incomplete at the composer’s death.

programme.title: Music of Naples
programme.desc: Throughout the centuries, the Italian city of Naples has proved to have a remarkably favorable climate for artistic innovation. The presence of the royal or vice royal courts, the practice of music in churches, fraternities, and charitable institutions, financial support from well-to-do citizens, and the popularity of song and dance in public life made for an extraordinarily diverse musical landscape.

programme.title: PIAM - Semi-final: Mendelssohn and Chopin
programme.desc: Acclaimed classical music talent scout Antonio Mormone (1930-2017) lives on as the name-giver of the Premio Internazionale Antonio Mormone (PIAM), awarded to the winner of the Italian music competition of the same name. The first edition of this competition, which was held in various venues in Milan from 2019 to 2021, was dedicated to the piano.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: The Pianists Keys
programme.desc: This documentary by Christoph Keller follows various participants and teachers participating in the International Summer Piano Academy.

programme.title: Mexican Concert - Part II
programme.desc: Raúl Delgado conducts the Orquesta Sinfonica de Minería in a concert program dedicated to Mexican composers. This program, which includes the second part of the concert, features the following works: Blas Galindo's 'Sones de Mariachi', Arturo Marquez's Danzón No. 2, José Pablo Moncayo's 'Huapango', and Genero Codina's 'March of Zacatecas'. This concert was recorded at the Academia de Música del Palacio de Minería in Mexico City in 2019.

programme.title: Shostakovich - Violin Concerto No. 1, Op. 77
programme.desc: In May 2019, the new principal conductor of the Gewandhaus, Andris Nelsons, presented Tchaikovsky’s Symphony No. 5 with his orchestra in combination with Shostakovich’s Violin Concerto No. 1 with outstanding violinist Baiba Skride as the soloist.

programme.title: Rina Sala Gallo Piano Competition 2022 - Finalists
programme.desc: The Rina Sala Gallo International Piano Competition takes place every two years in the Italian city of Monza. Founded in 1947 by Monza-born pianist Rina Sala Gallo and Brescia-born pianist Arturo Benedetti Michelangeli, the competition is one of Monza’s most prestigious cultural events today.

programme.title: Mozart - Piano Concertos No. 14 And No. 23
programme.desc: Regarded as one of the finest interpreters of Romantic repertoire, Francesco Attesti (*1975) gave his first recital at age 11 and by the time he was 23, had earned the highest honours in piano from Florence’s Conservatorio Luigi Cherubini. In this recording of his 2016 Deeply Mozart concert tour, Attesti performs Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart’s piano concertos KV 449 and KV 488 with the Italian OIDA Orchestra and conductor Paolo Belloli.

programme.title: Naples, City of Keyboards - Ascanio Mayone
programme.desc: ‘In compositions including passagework, out-of-tune notes which are not in accordance with the laws of counterpoint do indeed occasionally occur. But without them, a beautiful effect is not possible!’ Neapolitan Ascanio Mayone resolutely consigns criticism of his daring compositional style to the wastepaper basket. He has found the perfect ambassador in Louise Acabo: the impressive and very young winner of the Concours Corneille 2018.

programme.title: J. S. Bach - Arias, solos, and duets
programme.desc: Baritone Matthias Goerne teams up with violinist Vilde Frang, cellist Nicolas Altstaedt, flutist Stathis Karapanos, and harpsichordist Michaela Hasselt in this program dedicated to the music of J. S. Bach. They perform baritone arias from Bach’s most beautiful cantatas, as well as solo pieces and duets. On the program are Sonata No.

programme.title: Bruckner - Symphony No. 7
programme.desc: Franz Welser-Möst conducts the Cleveland Orchestra in a performance of Bruckner's Symphony No. 7. The work occupies a singularly important place in the composer's output. It was with this piece that Bruckner finally achieved widespread recognition and it has remained one of his most popular works. The symphony adheres to the classical four-movement format.

programme.title: Riccardo Chailly conducts Mendelssohn
programme.desc: Riccardo Chailly’s inaugural concert as Kapellmeister of the Leipzig Gewandhaus Orchestra captures the full atmosphere of a unique musical occasion. The concert centers round composer Felix Mendelssohn, who founded the Gewandhaus Orchestra in 1743. It includes an overwhelming performance of Mendelssohn’s Symphony No.

programme.title: Brahms - Violin Sonata No. 3, Op. 108
programme.desc: In this splendid 2013 concert from the Church of Verbier, Switzerland, Greek violinist Leonidas Kavakos and Chinese pianist Yuja Wang join forces to interpret three sonatas by Johannes Brahms. Leonidas Kavakos rose to fame in 1985, when he became the youngest musician to ever win the first price of the prestigious Sibelius Competition.

programme.title: In Rehearsal: Esa-Pekka Salonen
programme.desc: The Finnish composer and conductor Esa-Pekka Salonen (1958) was Music Director of the Los Angeles Philharmonic from 1992 until 2009. Under his dynamic leadership, it was recognized as one of the world's most outstanding orchestras. The exciting musical partnership Salonen established with his musicians was widely acclaimed in the international press.

programme.title: Mahler - Symphony No. 1
programme.desc: Jean Paul’s novel ‘Titan’, in which an artistically gifted young man, driven by his failure to find his way in society, eventually commits suicide in despair, inspired Gustav Mahler to compose his Symphony No. 1. The work did not come easily to Mahler: he composed it between 1887 and 1888 when he, in his twenties, was working as a conductor at the Oper Leipzig.

programme.title: Les Bains Macabres
programme.desc: French composer Guillaume Connesson (*1970) is building an impressive musical oeuvre, to which he has recently added an opera: 'Les bains macabres'. For this romantic contemporary thriller opera he worked closely with librettist Olivier Bleys (*1970), a successful French author with dozens of novels to his credit.

programme.title: Mozart - String Quartet No. 19 in C major, K. 465
programme.desc: Les Dissonances is a collective of artists founded by violinist David Grimal in 2004. The conductorless ensemble consists of musicians from the most prestigious European orchestras, international soloists, and young talents.

programme.title: Ravel - Sonata for violin and piano in G major
programme.desc: Japanese violinist Naoya Nishimura and Italian pianist Andrea Bacchetti perform Maurice Ravel’s Sonata for violin and piano (No. 2) in G major, M. 77. The sonata consists of three movements. The piece is often listed as “No. 2”, yet the composer wrote his actual second sonata, which remained unpublished until 38 years after his death, before this one. This performance was recorded at the Munetsugu Hall in Nagoya, Japan.

programme.title: Mariken in the Garden of Earthly Delights
programme.desc: The opera ‘Mariken in the Garden of Earthly Delights,’ to music by Calliope Tsoupaki, is based on the miracle play 'Mariken van Nieumeghen' (c. 1515). Over five centuries, this old story hasn’t lost a bit of its power and is unquestionably part of the canon of Dutch culture. In this opera, we follow the curious but vulnerable Mariken on a journey through a dark world.

programme.title: Mahler - Symphony No. 7
programme.desc: The Dutch conductor Bernard Haitink leads the Berliner Philharmoniker in the Seventh Symphony by Gustav Mahler, recorded at The Berliner Filharmonie in 1993. This symphony for a big orchestra premiered in 1908 in Prague under Mahler himself. Num ambiente de late night descontraído, o jornalista deixa de lado o fato e a gravata para receber convidados sentados no sofá, em conversas próximas sobre atualidade, cultura, entretenimento e histórias de vida que ajudam a contar o país.

programme.desc: Conversas simples em que cada host convida o seu mundo de pessoas. DUARTE CARRASCO. Duarte Carrasco é um fenómeno nas redes sociais. Brilhante aluno, cedo se interessou por política e cidadania.

programme.title: Minha Terra Minha Gente
programme.desc: “Minha Terra, Minha Gente” apresenta o melhor dos 308 concelhos do território, através da tradição, da inovação e da sustentabilidade. São empolgantes histórias de vida que personificam o amor à terra. Memórias das pessoas e dos locais, para as gerações futuras, com testemunhos marcantes e inspiradores de gente apaixonada: usos, costumes e tradições do rico património de Portugal. .

programme.title: Nova Oportunidade T1 - Ep. 21
programme.desc: NOVA OPORTUNIDADE é uma nova série dramática ambiciosa e de grande sucesso, com algumas das maiores estrelas da Turquia. A história centra-se em Deniz, uma mulher inocente que tem tudo o que poderia desejar na vida, até que o marido desaparece sem deixar rasto. Após perder tudo o que possuía, vê-se numa situação desesperada e enfrenta uma luta diária pela sobrevivência, necessitando de lutar pelo bem dos seus filhos e do seu pai idoso.

programme.title: O Jogo do Destino - Ep. 78
programme.desc: Bahar abre um curso profissional num bairro pobre para ajudar as donas de casa, e aí conhece Demir. O conflito entre ambos começa com uma confusão ao comprar uma sobremesa e num acidente de mota. Apesar da tensão, forma-se um laço. Quando Bahar fica presa num incêndio, Demir arrisca a própria vida para a salvar. Entretanto, Aysun planeia vingar-se de Harun, planeando casar com ele, matá-lo e começar uma nova vida com Demir.

programme.title: Ressurreição: Ertugru T2 - Ep. 41
programme.desc: Na segunda temporada, a tribo Kayi alia-se aos clãs turcomanos para resistir à invasão mongol. Ertugrul é capturado e torturado, mas escapa e regressa para enfrentar a traição, o exílio e planos maquiavélicos. Expõe conspirações, resgata o seu filho, derrota Noyan e leva o seu povo para oeste para fundar um novo estado.

programme.desc: Annual trade fair, exhibition, and festival jazzahead! is one of the international jazz community’s most important events. Hosted in Bremen, Germany, jazzahead! brings together musicians, bookers, agents, organizers, jazz experts, and music enthusiasts at the world’s largest jazz event. In 2024, jazzahead!

programme.title: jazzahead! 2022
programme.desc: Annual trade fair, exhibition, and festival jazzahead! is one of the international jazz community's most important events. Hosted in Bremen, Germany, jazzahead! brings together musicians, bookers, agents, organizers, jazz experts, and music enthusiasts at the world’s largest jazz event. In 2022, jazzahead!

programme.title: Arsenik - Olympia, Paris
programme.desc: The mythical duo Arsenik is a rap group from France, made up of two brothers, Lino and Calbo. The team performs at Olympia Paris to celebrate their 20 years since their first album, Quelques gouttes suffisent… It’s a unique concert: Arsenik plays the entire album with numerous special guests for the first time. The album has sold over 300,000 copies in France.

programme.title: Episode 3: Miles Davis - Jazz Greats
programme.desc: American trumpeter Miles Davis (1926-1991) was a pioneering jazz musician from the late 1940s to the late 1980s. His influence on 20th century music is hard to overstate, as he trailblazed bebop, cool jazz, hardbop, modal jazz, and electronic music. On October 11, 1964, Miles Davis performed at Teatro Dell’Arte in Milan.

programme.title: Misha Enzovoort
programme.desc: Misha Mengelberg, the forgetting has begun. He is waiting for a taxi he didn’t call to go to a performance that won’t take place. Dutch composer/pianist and grand duke of jazz Misha Mengelberg (1935) has been submerged in the shadow of dementia, ending his life as a musician. At the London jazz club Vortex in 2013 he impressively says his goodbyes to the international stage.

programme.title: WOMEX 2018
programme.desc: Since 1994, World Music Expo (WOMEX) has been attracting musicians, agents, a great number of press agencies, as well as media companies from all over the world. Its main exposition event has been held in various locations throughout Europe, including Berlin, Brussels, Marseille, Stockholm, Seville, Cardiff, and Budapest. The 2018 edition of WOMEX was held in Las Palmas, Gran Canaria.

programme.title: NSJ Vocal Selection: Carter, O'Day and Benjamin
programme.desc: The world-renowned North Sea Jazz Festival features a wide variety of genres, including traditional New Orleans jazz, swing, bop, free jazz, fusion, avant-garde and electronic jazz, blues, gospel, funk, soul, RAndB, hip hop, world beat and Latin. The festival was founded by entrepreneur and jazz fan Paul Acket, who sold his highly successful pop magazine publishing house to organize and fund the first edition of the festival in 1976.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: George Shearing Duo feat. Neil Swainson
programme.desc: British pianist George Shearing enjoyed an international reputation as an instrumentalist, arranger, and composer. Equally at home on the classical concert stage as in jazz clubs, he was recognized for his inventive, orchestrated jazz. In this live recording from the Munich Philharmonie, Shearing played in a duo format with Canadian double bassist Neil Swainson.

programme.title: Louis Armstrong: Live in Australia
programme.desc: Following a highly successful small-group jazz concert at New York Town Hall on May 17, 1947, Armstrong's manager Joe Glaser dissolved the Armstrong big band on August 13, 1947 and established a six-piece small group. This group was called the All Stars, and in 1964 Louis Armstrong recorded his biggest-selling record, Hello, Dolly!

programme.title: jazzahead! 2023 interview
programme.desc: These portraits of artists, concerts and festivals give a good impression of the jazz world. Both famous and less famous jazz artists will give a new insight in their life. DJAZZ asked them why they wrote that special song, what was the first record they bought and what is his or her most precious musical memory. The festival portraits are beautiful reports filmed at the most special jazz festivals and concerts.

programme.title: North Sea Jazz Club: Marnix Busstra Band
programme.desc: Guitarist, composer and director Marnix Busstra loves crossing borders. He travels the world with his jazz bands, plays guitar and bouzouki, writes jazz and theatre-songs, and co-creates and directs the exuberant theatre shows of his wife, the Dutch diva Karin Bloemen. Busstra is a constant wheel of invention, with technique expanded by his creative urge to find something new, an evolving state that adds immeasurably to his art.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Sia - Live at The Metro Theatre
programme.desc: The Australian-born singer-songwriter Sia Kate Isobelle Furler, simply known as Sia, is one of the most unique artists in today's popular music scene. However, her path to stardom has been nothing but rocky. Only after numerous musical experimentations, where the singer tried to establish herself in her home country as well as United Kingdom, Sia finally blossomed in United States around the second decade of the 21st century.

programme.title: Franco Ambrosetti Quintet live at Estival Lugano
programme.desc: Since 1977, Estival is a summer jazz festival in Switzerland, Lugano. Estival offers a thrilling and particularly surprising line-up that explores the rich world of contemporary music whilst promoting the understanding of different cultures, tolerance, and co-existence. The composer, trumpeter and bugle player Franco Ambrosetti performs with his quintet in his native Lugano as part of the Estival.

programme.title: BIRDtv: Badbadnotgood
programme.desc: Rotterdam’s ‘ BIRD’ is a club, café and restaurant with a live music programme that's deeply rooted in jazz, and also branches out towards soul, funk, hip-hop and electronic music as well. Its name ‘BIRD’ refers to the nickname of the legendary New York jazz saxophonist, bebop co-founder Charlie Parker (1920-1955). BIRD serves Neapolitan pizzas, good wines, no-nonsense beers and an all-round metropolitan rawness.

programme.title: Where Are We Now - Part I
programme.desc: German jazz and cabaret singer Atrin Madani was born in 1998 as the son of Iranian immigrants. In the face of pandemic uncertainty, geopolitical upheaval, and social unrest in his ancestral home country, Madani asked himself: where are we now? His response to this question is as clear and precise as his singing: what we need most right now is honesty, humility, and quality.

programme.desc: The Royal Concertgebouw in Amsterdam is a world-renowned concert hall, known for its first-rate acoustics. It has attracted many famous performers over the years and is one of the Netherlands' most treasured musical institutions. On November 2, 1958, American jazz titan Duke Ellington and his Orchestra performed two concerts at the Concertgebouw in Amsterdam.

programme.title: Ella Fitzgerald - Antibes Jazz Festival
programme.desc: The 1964 edition of the Antibes Jazz Festival in Juan-les-Pins saw the return of the First Lady of Song, Ella Fitzgerald. Together with Roy Eldridge on trumpet, Tommy Flanagan on piano, Bill Yancey on double bass, and Gus Johnson on drums, the tireless singer performed such classics from the Great American songbook such as 'Them There Eyes', 'The Lady Is a Tramp', 'Summertime', 'I'm Putting all My Eggs in One Basket', 'St.

programme.title: Paradox Live: BRUUT!
programme.desc: Innovative contemporary jazz and improvised music, the search for modernity, mind blowing sounds, rock and pop… Indeed PARADOX Tilburg goes beyond jazz, crossing musical boundaries into the unknown soundscapes of electronic music. Indie artists, blues veterans and jazz superstars all pour their hearts and souls at the Paradox.

programme.title: DJAZZ Portrait: Jazz à Vienne
programme.desc: These portraits of artists, concerts and festivals give a good impression of the jazz world. Both famous and less famous jazz artists will give a new insight in their life. DJAZZ asked them why they wrote that special song, what was the first record they bought and what is his or her most precious musical memory. The festival portraits are beautiful reports filmed at the most special jazz festivals and concerts.

programme.title: Blue Note: A Story of Modern Jazz - Part II
programme.desc: Art Blakey, Dexter Gordon, Ron Carter, Herbie Hancock, Thelonious Monk... these names are synonymous with the great Jazz Age. But how many people know Alfred Lion and Francis Wolff, to whom we owe the recorded memory of our Jazz legends? Two German Jews who emigrated from Nazi Germany to New York 'discovered' an American art form which at the time received little serious attention from mainstream America: Jazz Music.

programme.title: Classic Meets Jazz
programme.desc: Tzimon Barto, the young American classical pianist and Wolfgang Dauner, the internationally renowned German jazz pianist join their talents to show how multi-dimensional music can be.

programme.title: Benny Goodman Septet - North Sea Jazz Part II
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by.

programme.title: Tribute to Django Reinhardt: Rosenberg meets Beets
programme.desc: World-class Dutch jazz pianist Peter Beets has shared the stage with jazz greats Chick Corea, Wynton Marsalis, “Toots” Thielemans, Elvin Jones, George Coleman, Johnny Griffin, Benny Golson, and John Clayton. His mother a music teacher and his father an Oscar Peterson and Art Blakey enthusiast, Beets was surrounded by music from an early age.

programme.title: Malta Jazz Festival
programme.desc: Vocalist Jazzmeia Horn’s 2019 Malta Jazz Festival appearance was a celebration of jazz’s future, infused with the soul of its past. Featuring Keith Brown (piano), Rashaan Carter (bass), Irwin Hall (flute and saxophone), and Anwar Marshall (drums), the young singer’s performance was a reminder of jazz’s enduring power to speak to the heart.

programme.title: Funk in Deep Freeze
programme.desc: Two top-tier Belgian musicians – guitarist Philip Catherine and bassist Jean-Louis Rassinfosse – accompany American jazz trumpeter and vocalist Chet Baker during this 1985 performance at the beautiful Brussels Jazz Club, located on the Grand-Place, the Belgian capital’s central square. The trio plays Charlie Mariano’s “Crystal Bells”, the title track of their acclaimed 1983 album.

programme.title: Songs She Never Heard
programme.desc: In 2019, the vibrant city of Sofia, Bulgaria, hosted the International A to JazZ Festival. Among the featured acts was the trailblazing jazz trumpeter Christian Scott aTunde Adjuah. This genre-defying artist captivated the audience with his eclectic “stretch music”; an approach that incorporates hip-hop and reaches back through the American canon into African percussion and its rich melodic content.

programme.title: Great Guitarists - Collage
programme.desc: This selection of unforgettable performances by some of the most iconic and influential jazz guitarists in history showcases these legends’ unique essence. Revel in Wes Montgomery’s virtuosity as he performs the captivating “Nica's Dream” in Holland in 1965, and delight in the expressive beauty of his rendition of “Here's That Rainy Day”, recorded in London in that same year.

programme.title: Mike Stern And Didier Lockwood: Jazz à Vienne
programme.desc: Guitarist Mike Stern and violin player Didier Lockwood sharing a stage: that promises a good show! After playing for years with Blood, Sweat And Tears, Mike Stern landed a gig with drummer Billy Cobham and then broke through with Miles Davis’ comeback band in the 1980s. Didier Lockwood played in jazz fusion band Magma during the 1970s and is known for his use of electric amplification and experimentation.

programme.title: Tribute to Django Reinhardt: Bireli Lagrene
programme.desc: Biréli Lagrène is a French jazz guitarist born on September 4, 1966 in a family of gypsy tradition. His brother and his father introduced him from an early age to the repertoire of Django Reinhardt, whose influence is still felt in the style of Lagrène. In this performance, Lagrène pays homage to Django Reinhardt with his son, Babik Reinhardt.

programme.title: Live at Beck’s Festival Bar
programme.desc: The UK based band Metronomy started out as a bedroom project by Joseph Mount, who during its early stages was the sole contributor to the band's repertoire. After the debut release, Mount started expanding the band's personnel: first by adding two members, and later increasing it by one more.

programme.title: Portrait of Maria Ana Bobone
programme.desc: Maria Ana Bobone (Portugal) is one of the best fado singers of her generation. She started singing fado when she was 16. Her debut album is called ‘Alma Nova’ and marked the beginning of her amazing career. For the recordings of her next two albums, ‘Luz Destino’ and ‘Senhora da Lapa’ Maria Ana welcomed instruments that are usually not present in fado music: the harpsichord and saxophone.

programme.title: PC Qwintett: 75th year of Courbois
programme.desc: Pierre Courbois has been one of Europe’s leading jazz musicians since the mid-sixties. This concert, recorded at the renowned Amsterdam jazz club Bimhuis, sees the drummer playing with his QWINTETT. On the occasion of his 75th birthday in 2015, Courbois hit the road for the Pierre Courbois 75 Years Anniversary Tour.

programme.title: MotorMusic Jazz Session: From Rossini to Piazzolla
programme.desc: The MotorMusic Studios in Mechelen, Belgium, attract many great musicians to the city. A wide variety of visiting international jazz musicians share their art of making jazz music with us in the DJAZZ series ‘Belgium Sessions’. In these sessions, some of Europe’s finest musicians perform their own, original music.

programme.title: Live at A to JazZ Festival, Sofia
programme.desc: In 2019, the vibrant city of Sofia, Bulgaria, hosted the International A to JazZ Festival. Among the featured acts was the trailblazing jazz trumpeter Christian Scott aTunde Adjuah. This genre-defying artist captivated the audience with his eclectic “stretch music”; an approach that incorporates hip-hop and reaches back through the American canon into African percussion and its rich melodic content.

programme.title: Michel Tasky live in Rio: Um Malandro em Paris
programme.desc: With his relaxed and clear voice, Belgian-born vocalist Michel Tasky took his French-Waalse roots to Brazil, where he established himself in the jazz scene. His contemporary style, which blends jazz and French chanson with a whole lot of samba, transports audiences to faraway places.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Jazz Open Stuttgart: West Coast All Stars
programme.desc: This live recording is celebrating 50 years of West Coast Jazz. The West Coast Jazz movement had its origins about 50 years ago in Los Angeles. It was essentially a 'cool' form of jazz played mostly by studio musicians as a break from their studio work. The West Coast All Stars are specially brought together for this West Coast Night.

programme.title: Count Basie and his Orchestra live in Charleroi
programme.desc: Count Basie is one of the most important bandleaders of the swing era. With the exception of a brief period in the early '50s, he led a big band from 1935 until his death almost 50 years later. Basie's orchestra was characterized by a light, swinging rhythm section that he led from the piano, lively ensemble work, and generous soloing. Basie was not a composer like Duke Ellington or an important soloist like Benny Goodman.

programme.title: Rita Reys And The Pim Jacobs Trio at North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: The world-renowned North Sea Jazz Festival features a wide variety of genres, including traditional New Orleans jazz, swing, bop, free jazz, fusion, avant-garde and electronic jazz, blues, gospel, funk, soul, RAndB, hip hop, world beat and Latin. The festival was founded by entrepreneur and jazz fan Paul Acket, who sold his highly successful pop magazine publishing house to organize and fund the first edition of the festival in 1976.

programme.title: Scott DuBois Quartet Live In Munich
programme.desc: Rising star of the jazz guitar Scott DuBois leads his quartet, consisting of Gebhard Ullmann (reeds), Thomas Morgan (bass), and Kresten Osgood (drums), in an intimate and atmospheric performance at Munich’s Jazz Club Unterfahrt in March 2016. The group’s telepathy is such that they are able to go from deathly quiet to fiercely avant-garde at the drop of a hat.

programme.title: jazzahead! 2024 interview - Julia Kadel
programme.desc: These portraits of artists, concerts and festivals give a good impression of the jazz world. Both famous and less famous jazz artists will give a new insight in their life. These portraits were recorded at jazzahead! 2024 in Bremen, Germany.

programme.title: Tim Kliphuis and the NCO: The Changing Seasons
programme.desc: The Netherlands Chamber Orchestra commissioned violinist Tim Kliphuis, internationally known for his genre-crossing approach to music, to write a new version of Antonio Vivaldi's ‘Four Seasons’. Kliphuis choose to take improvisation as his starting point; at the same time, he intended to leave the best-known Vivaldi themes and chords in, as they give the piece its wonderful energy.

programme.title: Salif Keita And Les Ambassadeurs
programme.desc: Salif Keita’s music is a rich combination of traditional Malian music with European and American influences. We can hear this in the instrumentation of Keita’s music, which varies from traditional West-African instruments to Western European ones. The Malian singer was cast out by his family because of his albinism. In 1967 he moved to Bamako, where he started his musical career and joined Les Ambassadeurs (Internationaux).

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Comblain-la-Tour Jazz Festival: Jimmy McGriff Trio
programme.desc: As one of the best Hammond B3 organ players, Jimmy McGriff (1936-2008) is often lost among great soul-jazz organists from his hometown of Philadelphia. Of the major soul-jazz pioneers, he was the bluesiest and often insisted that he was more of a blues musician than a jazz artist. Regardless, he remained eclectic enough to blur the lines of genres.

programme.title: Tania Maria Trio - North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by.

programme.title: Oum - Music Meeting Festival 2018
programme.desc: Oum El Ghait Benessahraoui, who is better known as Oum, gives a unique glance at ethnic Morrocan musical esthetics. The singer-songwriter is considered to be the ambassador of Morrocan culture, too. Deeply influenced by gospel, jazz, soul and RAndB genres, today Oum mixes more and more African music genres, such as Sufi, Hassani, or Afrobeat.

programme.title: Kurt Rosenwinkel meets Peter Beets Trio
programme.desc: The Dutch world-class jazz pianist Peter Beets has shared the stage with jazz greats like Chick Corea, Wynton Marsalis, “Toots” Thielemans, Elvin Jones, George Coleman, Johnny Griffin, Benny Golson and John Clayton. From birth, Beets was surrounded by music: he heard classical music from his mother, who is a music pedagogue, and he heard jazz from his father, who has a great fan of Oscar Peterson and Art Blakey.

programme.title: The Hammond© Sessions: Dede Priest
programme.desc: The Dutch Hammond organ player Rob Mostert develops, in cooperation with Stingray DJAZZ, the program Mostert Meets. In this series, the Hammond B3 organ takes center stage. Rob Mostert invites the world’s finest jazz musicians for a musical collaboration, in which the Hammond Organ plays a major role.

programme.title: Duke Ellington Orchestra - Het Concertgebouw
programme.desc: The Royal Concertgebouw in Amsterdam is a world-renowned concert hall, known for its first-rate acoustics. It has attracted many famous performers over the years and is one of the Netherlands' most treasured musical institutions. On November 2, 1958, American jazz titan Duke Ellington and his Orchestra performed two concerts at the Concertgebouw in Amsterdam.
